_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Warranty Performance Report
summary: Provides information on items under warranty, including contractor repair, replacement, and reimbursement, and equipment failure data associated with Reliability Improvement Warranties (RIW).
applicable_forms: DD Form 250 Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Control Number 0704-0248
use_relationship:
The Warranty Performance Report provides information on items under warranty; contractor repair, replacement, and reimbursement; and equipment failure data associated with Reliability Improvement Warranties (RIW).

a. The data is used to track and assess the effectiveness and implementation of the contract warranty provisions; to apprise the government of the type, severity, and frequency of failures; to verify warranty coverage for each item delivered; and to document warranty periods and delivery schedules.

b. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.

c. The warranty status section of this DID is used to warranty provisions where individual warranted item identification is required, and remedies include repair, replacement, and reimbursement. The warranty data section is used to warranty provisions where a RIW is delineated in the contract or data on reliability and performance achievement is required.

d. This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81639A.

references.label: DD Form 250, Material Inspection and Receiving Report - forms available online

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Warranty Performance Report shall be in government-approved contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Warranty Performance Report shall delineate data for each contract line item (CLIN) covered by the warranty.  The Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Header information
children.content: The header information shall include:

children.title: Calendar reporting period covered by the report
Repair facility address, including city, state, and zip code
Warrantor's Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) code
Warrantor's Department of Defense Activity Address Code (DoDAAC)
Warranted item information
children.content: The warranted item information for each CLIN covered by a warranty delivered to the Government during the reporting period, which shall include:

children.title: Government issued nomenclature (noun)
children.content: in accordance with MIL-STD-1812 Aeronautical and Support Equipment Type Designation System.

children.title: Delivery date
children.content: Completed DD Form 250, Material Inspection and Receiving Report. (Copies of this form are available online at https://www.esd.whs.mil/Directives/forms/)

children.title: In-service date
children.content: (i.e., Date when the warranted items are turned over to field users).

children.title: Cumulative data
children.content: Cumulative data of 3.1.2 for CLIN items delivered under the contract to the Government from start date of contract award to the end date of the reporting period.

children.title: Cumulative data
children.content: Cumulative data of 3.1.2 for CLIN items delivered under the contract to the Government for which the warranty has expired from the start date of contract award to the end date of the reporting period.

children.title: Contractor's plant warranty repair or replacement information
children.content: For CLINs returned for repair or replacement at the contractor's facility during the reporting period, the following information shall be included:

children.title: NSN and Government issued nomenclature of the returned CLIN
Date returned CLIN received at contractor's facility
Action taken
children.content: (i.e., Repaired, replaced, awaiting action, or shipped).

children.title: NSN(s), part number(s), and quantity of repair parts used
Cost (U.S. dollars) of repair or replacement
children.content: including parts and labor, and base year for the dollar amounts.

children.title: Cost (U.S. dollars) of failure
children.content: and base year for the dollar amounts.

children.title: On-site contractor warranty repair or replacement
children.content: For CLINs repaired or replaced during the reporting period, for which repairs or replacements are performed by the contractor or the contractor's designated representative at the contractor's facility or dealership, the following information shall be included:

children.title: NSN and Government issued nomenclature of the CLIN
Action taken
children.content: (i.e., Repaired, replaced, awaiting action, or shipped).

children.title: NSN(s), part number(s), and quantity of repair parts used
Cost (U.S. dollars) of repair or replacement
children.content: including parts and labor, and base year for the dollar amounts.

children.title: Cost (U.S. dollars) of failure
children.content: and base year for the dollar amounts.

children.title: Warranty repair contractor reimbursements to the Government
children.content: When the Government submits a warranty claim reimbursement to the contractor for Government costs expended for warranty repair during the reporting period, the contractor's reimbursement to the Government shall include the following:

children.title: Government claim (U.S. dollars) amount
children.content: and base year for the dollar amount.

children.title: Contractor reimbursement (U.S. dollars) amount
children.content: and base year for the dollar amount.

children.title: Reason for denial of reimbursement
children.content: if applicable.

children.title: Reason for lesser amount of reimbursement than Government claim amount
children.content: if applicable.

children.title: Cumulative data
children.content: for 3.1.3, 3.1.4, and 3.1.5 shall be included from the start date of contract award to the end date of the reporting period.

children.title: Remarks
children.content: Contractor comments and recommendations regarding the warranty status information, including improvements, changes, or other specific details, shall be provided, as needed.

children.title: Program summary
children.content: The program summary information shall include:

children.title: Program detail
children.content: The program or RIW start date, reporting period start date, and reporting period cut-off date.

children.title: Utilization details
children.content: The average operating time (AOT) and total operating hours (TOH) for the average quantity of installed systems.

children.title: Repair detail
children.content: The quantity of units returned subdivided by: exclusions, which shall include a quantity and a percent of total units returned; non-verified failures, which shall include a quantity and a percent of total units returned; and quantity of warranted failures, warranty units repaired, and quantity of total repair days.

children.title: Performance statistics
children.content: The achieved mean time between failures (MTBF) and average turn-around time (TAT).

children.title: Program status
children.content: The number of days from the start of the contract warranty, TOH from start of the contract warranty, warranty used, and warranty remaining.

children.title: Unit summary
children.content: A unit summary of the activity for each type unit, line replaceable unit (LRU), and shop replaceable unit (SRU), which shall include:

children.title: Delivery and processing status
children.content: The number of total units delivered and units returned subdivided by: exclusions, which shall include a quantity and a percentage of total units returned; non-verified failures, which shall include a quantity and a percentage of total units returned; and quantity of warranted failures, quantity in repair, quantity in secure storage, quantity shipped, quantity condemned or lost, quantity on consignment, repair man hours, repair parts, and material costs.

children.title: Utilization details
children.content: The average quantity of units installed and TOH.

children.title: Unit cycle time
children.content: The unit cycle time shall include the average days for the following segments: shipment-to-contractor-receipt, contractor-receipt-to-storage, storage-to-shipment, shipment-to-installation, installation-to-removal, and removal-to-shipment.

children.title: Unit performance
children.content: MTBF guaranteed, MTBF achieved, TAT guaranteed, and TAT achieved.

children.title: Unit detail
children.content: Historical activity of all delivered units as follows: unit SN; date sent to or located in storage; date of material release order (MRO); date shipped; elapsed time indicator (ETI) read in; ETI read out; configuration codes; shipping destination; date installed; aircraft and equipment type, tail number, and SN; date removed; date shipped to contractor; date received by contractor; originating activity; and RIW repair code (e.g., warranty exclusion, non-verified failure, warranty failure).

children.title: Modification status summary
children.content: A modification status summary for each type unit, LRU, and SRU, which shall contain all engineering change proposals (ECP) submitted for reliability improvements as follows: ECP number, date submitted, date approved, status code (e.g., government approval, automatic approval, disapproval), configuration code(s) applicable to the specific weapon system (e.g., F-16 A-Model block 01/05/10/15 Type/Version [T/V]:61]; B-Model block 01/05/10/15 T/V:62; C-Model block 25/30/32 T/V:5C), production effectivity (date), quantity of units, total percentage of units affected by the ECP, and total percentage of units with the ECP completed.

children.title: Consignment spares inventory list
children.content: The consignment spares inventory list shall include the following for each consignment spare: number of units, if the spare is a LRU or a SRU, if the spare is on consignment or loan to the Government include the date of consignment, nomenclature, and SN.

children.title: Parts consumption list
children.content: The parts consumption list shall include a list organized in alphabetical or numerical order, of all parts associated with or contained in the equipment under warranty, including the total quantity of each part consumed during repair actions, and a description of all repair actions completed from the warranty start date through the required report cut-off date.
